title: Get TTO Public Media Insights
content_data:
Use this endpoint to get information about the videos of a creator on [TikTok One (TTO) Creator Marketplace](https://ads.tiktok.com/creative/creatormarketplace). ## Comparing TCM and TTO Creator Marketplace endpoints The following table outlines the differences between TikTok Creator Marketplace (TCM) and TTO Creator Marketplace endpoints. ```xtable | Changes {24%}| TCM Endpoint{36%} | TTO Creator Marketplace Endpoint{40%} | |---|---|---| | Endpoint path | /v1.3/tcm/creator/public/video/list/| /v1.3/tto/tcm/creator/public/video/list/ | | Same request parameters | `video_ids`
`cursor`
`limit` | `video_ids`
`cursor`
`limit` | | Deprecated request parameters | N/A | `creator_id` | | New request parameters | N/A | `tto_tcm_account_id`
`handle_name` | | Same response parameters | `posts`
`posts.video_id`
`posts.caption`
`posts.likes`
`posts.comments`
`posts.shares`
`posts.video_views`
`posts.embed_url`
`posts.thumbnail_url`
`posts.create_time`
`posts.display_name`
`page_info`
`page_info.has_more`
`page_info.cursor` | `posts`
`posts.video_id`
`posts.caption`
`posts.likes`
`posts.comments`
`posts.shares`
`posts.video_views`
`posts.embed_url`
`posts.thumbnail_url`
`posts.create_time`
`posts.display_name`
`page_info`
`page_info.has_more`
`page_info.cursor` | | Deprecated response parameters | N/A | `posts.engagement_count`
`posts.engagement_rate` | | New response parameters | N/A | `posts.favorites` | ``` ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/tto/tcm/creator/public/video/list/ **Method** GET **Header** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Access token authorized by a TTO Creator Marketplace account.
For details, see [Authentication](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/obtain-authorization-and-authentication-from-a-tto-creator-marketplace-account/v1.3).| ``` **Parameters** ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |tto_tcm_account_id {Required}|string|The ID of the TTO Creator Marketplace account.

To obtain the IDs of the accounts that you can access via `Access-Token`, use [/tto/oauth2/tcm/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1815693478150146).| |handle_name {Required}|string|The handle name of the TTO Creator Marketplace creator that you want to search for.

The exact match is supported.

Note: If you specify the handle name of a creator that is not on TTO Creator Marketplace yet, an error will occur.| |video_ids|string[]|The IDs of the videos to filter the results by.

Max size: 25.

If this field is not specified, the results won't be filtered by video IDs.| |cursor|number|The timestamp cursor of the video from which you want to retrieve subsequent videos.

If the response parameter `has_more` is `true`, pass the returned `cursor` to this parameter in the next request to retrieve the subsequent videos.

Default value: 0. By default, the most recent videos will be returned.| |limit|number|The number of posts to return for each request.

Value range: 1-25.

Default value: 10.| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request GET 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/tto/tcm/creator/public/video/list/?tto_tcm_account_id={{tto_tcm_account_id}}&handle_name={{handle_name}}' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{access_token}}' \ (/code) ``` ## Response ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |code |number|Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix-Return Code](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097). | |message|string|Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |request_id |string|The log ID of a request, which uniquely identifies the request. | |data |object|Returned data.| #|posts|object[]|The list of public posts of the creator.| ##|display_name|string|The display name of the creator.| ##|video_id|string|Unique identifier for the video.

Example: `1234567890`.| ##|thumbnail_url|string|Temporary URL for the video thumbnail.

Validity period: around seven days.

The expiration time is included in the URL after the `x-expires` parameter, in the format of an Epoch/Unix timestamp in seconds.

Once the URL expires, you need to call [/tto/tcm/creator/public/video/list/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1828185411810305) to obtain a new URL.| ##|embed_url|string|An embeddable link for this TikTok video. This URL can be used to embed the TikTok video in external websites or applications.

If the privacy setting of the post is "Friends" or "Only you", the video will not be viewable through this link.| ##|caption|string|Video description.| ##|likes|integer|Likes.
Total number of likes on the video.

Example: 100.| ##|comments|integer|Comments.
Total number of comments on the video.

Example: 100.| ##|shares|integer|Shares.
Total number of times the video has been shared.

Example: 100.| ##|favorites|integer|Favorites.
The total number of times the video has been added to favorites.

Example: 100.| ##|video_views|integer|Video views.
The number of times viewers who watched the video.

Example: 100.

Note: Replays will not be counted.| ##|create_time|string|The time when the video was created, in Unix/epoch timestamp in milliseconds (UTC+0 time).

Example: `1743090990000`.| ##|caption_hashtags|string[]|A list of hashtags that appear in the post caption. ##|mentioned_accounts|string[]|A list of the display names of TikTok accounts that have been @mentioned in the post caption. ##|collaboration_status|string|A status indicating if the post has been used as Branded Content.

Enum values:
  • `PAID_PARTNERSHIP`: Posts linked to TTO Campaign Links.
  • `CREATOR_EARNS_COMMISSION`: TikTok Shop creator earns commission from affiliate links, learn more [here](https://ads.tiktok.com/help/article/faqs-affiliate-creatives-authorization?lang=en).
  • `NONE`
    • #|page_info|object|Pagination information.| ##|has_more|boolean|Whether more videos are available.

    Supported values: `true`, `false`.| ##|cursor|integer|The timestamp cursor that marks the time of the last video returned in the current request.

    If `has_more` in the response is `true`, you can pass the value to the `cursor` parameter in your subsequent request to retrieve subsequent posts.

    Example: `1734031433000`.| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "page_info": { "cursor": 1734031433000, "has_more": false }, "posts": [ { "caption": "{{caption}}", "comments": 0, "create_time": "1734031433000", "display_name": "{{display_name}}", "embed_url": "{{embed_url}}", "favorites": 0, "likes": 3, "shares": 1, "thumbnail_url": "{{thumbnail_url}}", "video_id": "{{video_id}}", "video_views": 236 } ] } } (/code) ```
